versions.label: Version 1 · printed prototype
versions.note: Checkpoint ade5b54 · accepted collar fit · full hardware BOM. Physical mechanism remains unvalidated.

versions.label: Version 2 · compact shaft-side rails
versions.note: Rotate phone end-for-end for outer-edge buttons. Both actuator positions now near shaft; rotated camera framing unresolved.

versions.label: Version 3 · removable cuffs and sliding plunger
versions.note: V3: pulley groove doubled to 2.2 mm depth with 36-degree flanks. PETG slice has zero support paths; physical string retention remains untested. Single TPU clip and common TPU fasteners retained.
